_comment: Sample return names / ReturnIds shown in the guided prompts, per chatbot version (APP_VERSION). Edit this file to change the examples - no code or frontend change is needed; it is re-read automatically when it changes. Actions: check_report_status, generate_instance, schedule_report, comparative_analysis (the last prompt reads '... short name to compare (e.g. ...):'). Each action maps to an ordered list of samples; the prompt reads 'Enter the report name, ReturnId, or short name (e.g. <samples joined by comma>):'.
